title: Saturn V reference ascent
summary: The supplied Saturn V Flight Lab 2.0 model, run through the legacy adapter with its default configuration. The physics file is byte-identical to the supplied source.
expected_behaviour: Three-stage ascent to a low Earth parking orbit of about 180-190 km with max-q near 79 s and peak sensed acceleration below 5 g.
acceptance_checks: Orbit is reached (perigee altitude above 150 km).
Stage separation events appear in order S-IC, S-II, S-IVB cutoff.
